step_rule: Numerically locate nearest angular branch crossing c up to cap. h_top=min(cap,0.8*c); coarse/middle/audit=h_top*[1,0.8,0.6]. All three centered stencils must be branch safe. No response-adaptive selection or fallback.
branch_guard_scope: Floating point quartic-root geometry guard and nine-point check of actual rounded positions at every stencil. Three internal gC knots only, not every REBO branch or interval proof.
roundoff_rule: Extended-precision affine construction, one rounding to native double; no derivative correction. Minimum step1e-6 Angstrom. Norm of actual Cartesian central direction minus nominal <=1e-6. Middle derivative repeated with reversed sampling order: max absolute difference <1e-7 eV/Angstrom^2. All projected baseline forces <=1e-7 eV/Angstrom and repeat differences <=1e-12. Actual input errors are diagnostics, not a rigorous force-error bound; adjacent derivative agreement remains mandatory.
purpose: Exposed-data numerical qualification of four unchanged stationary affine references. Not physical preregistration.
scope: Four full 79/151 coordinate matrices and9 normalized directions per case, cutoff24 Angstrom width2 imposed smooth KCz + REBO. No physical bath/friction/clock identification.
directions: Three old sine, three old cosine sqrt2/3/5 regression directions plus three previously unused cosine sqrt7/11/13 directions. Same branch and roundoff rule applies to every column and direction.
matrix_rule: Retain middle derivative per column. Require both adjacent matrix max-entry and relative Frobenius changes, every column relative change, retained relative antisymmetry<1e-6. All column middle derivatives repeat in reverse force order.
direction_rule: Every direction must pass both adjacent absolute/relative changes, middle derivative agreement with new symmetrized middle matrix, and reverse-order repeat.
stability: Positive resolved if lambda_min(symHmid)>max(1e-7,10*max spectral adjacent matrix discrepancy); full qualification includes this diagnostic, not an interval theorem.
preflight: All selected stencils in all columns/directions must pass numerical angular and representation checks before any fresh force collection. Any failure gives HOLD with no fallback.
